assurance_contract.scope: Fresh 2026-09-24 full DTG/VTC clean-room portfolio assessment using immutable normative, realization, privacy-specialist and executable-evidence sources.
assurance_contract.non_scope: Production deployment certification, future unpinned upstream work, or conclusions unsupported by the immutable source set.
scenarios: A consequential action crosses credential, Trust Task, proof, authority and VTC realization boundaries.
Authority or lifecycle state changes between evidence creation and consequential execution.
A holder, delegate or agent crosses relying contexts and correlation/disclosure surfaces are examined.
A verifier relies on historical or current state while source, status, policy and retained evidence may diverge.
risks: proof, possession, identity, delegation or capability being mistaken for current authority
stale or over-broad authority surviving lifecycle or revocation change
replay, retry or task/credential binding mismatch producing unintended actuation
cross-context correlation through identifiers, status, policy, proof or retained evidence
historical and current truth being conflated
normative and implementation versions diverging while appearing aligned
discovery or recognition being misread as authorization
harms: reliance on stale or semantically incomplete evidence
false assurance caused by composition or source-authority drift
assurance_propositions: delegation, identity, capability, key possession, proof validity and current authority remain non-substitutable
current implementation materially conforms to adopted credential and task semantics where it claims support
Trust Task authorization and invocation boundaries do not enlarge credential or proof authority
replay/idempotency behavior does not create a second authorization path
presenter, subject, controller and relationship bindings are preserved across composed paths
correlation scope and disclosure behavior do not create unnecessary durable cross-context joins
status, policy, discovery and retained evidence do not silently become authority or correlation surfaces
historical-state answers are distinguishable from current-state answers and preserve evidentiary basis
all maintained DTG cross-spec compositions have a terminal evidence-backed disposition
the current OpenVTC realization remains distinguishable from normative baselines wherever divergent or incomplete
tests: DTG VDC × VAC semantic non-substitution negative vectors

actions.action: Resolve only evidence-backed residuals emitted by the fresh portfolio and cross-specification campaign.
actions.acceptance_criterion: Each residual has immutable evidence, an attributable owner, severity, priority and a falsifiable retest or closure condition.

assessment.title: Full DTG/VTC clean-room assurance campaign — 2026-09-24
